description: UPI failure classification catalog. Agents must classify using these entries only.

classifications.rootCause: Remitter bank did not respond within configured timeout
classifications.recommendedAction: Retry after verifying bank availability. If failures increase, create a bank incident.
matchHints: Transaction timed out while waiting for response from remitter bank

classifications.rootCause: Customer does not have sufficient available balance
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry automatically. Customer should add funds or use another payment method.

classifications.rootCause: Fraud risk engine rejected the transaction
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry automatically. Review customer and transaction risk indicators.
matchHints: Transaction rejected because risk threshold was exceeded

classifications.rootCause: Axis Bank UPI backend service is unavailable
classifications.recommendedAction: Avoid repeated retries. Check bank service health and create incident if failures are widespread.
matchHints: Issuer bank UPI service is unavailable

classifications.rootCause: Beneficiary VPA could not be resolved
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry automatically. Ask customer to verify beneficiary UPI ID.

classifications.rootCause: Issuer bank processing exceeded expected response time
classifications.recommendedAction: Query transaction status before initiating another payment.
matchHints: No final response received from issuer bank

classifications.rootCause: Same transaction reference was submitted more than once
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry. Verify status of original transaction.

classifications.rootCause: Bank UPI service is unavailable or severely degraded
classifications.recommendedAction: Create operational incident and monitor failure rate. Avoid aggressive retries.

classifications.rootCause: Customer entered incorrect UPI PIN
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry automatically. Customer should enter correct PIN or reset it.

classifications.rootCause: Bank connector connection pool is exhausted
classifications.recommendedAction: Create technical incident and investigate pool utilization, connection leaks and downstream latency.
matchHints: Unable to acquire connection from bank connection pool

classifications.rootCause: Issuer bank rejected transaction based on account or transaction restrictions
classifications.recommendedAction: Verify account restrictions. Do not repeatedly retry.
matchHints: Transaction not permitted by issuer bank

classifications.rootCause: Customer reached configured daily transaction limit
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry. Customer should retry after limit reset or use another payment method.

classifications.rootCause: Beneficiary bank rejected credit request
classifications.recommendedAction: Retry later after verifying beneficiary bank availability.

classifications.rootCause: Customer account has a UPI debit restriction
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry. Customer must contact bank to remove restriction.
matchHints: Debit account is blocked for UPI transactions

classifications.rootCause: UPI transaction did not receive timely response from NPCI network
classifications.recommendedAction: Check NPCI connectivity and monitor transaction failure rate before retrying.
matchHints: NPCI response timeout exceeded configured threshold

classifications.rootCause: Registered device validation failed
classifications.recommendedAction: Re-register the device with PSP application. Do not retry automatically.

classifications.rootCause: Customer did not authorize collect request within allowed period
classifications.recommendedAction: Generate a new collect request.

classifications.rootCause: Beneficiary UPI ID is currently disabled
classifications.recommendedAction: Ask beneficiary to verify UPI account status.

classifications.rootCause: Requested transaction exceeds configured amount limit
classifications.recommendedAction: Reduce transaction amount or use another payment method.
matchHints: Transaction amount exceeds permitted UPI limit

classifications.rootCause: PSP lost network connectivity while processing transaction
classifications.recommendedAction: Check PSP network health and retry only after transaction status is confirmed.
matchHints: Network connection lost during transaction processing

classifications.rootCause: UPI profile is mapped to an unavailable bank account
classifications.recommendedAction: Ask customer to re-link the bank account.
matchHints: Mapped bank account could not be located

classifications.rootCause: Beneficiary account cannot receive UPI credits
classifications.recommendedAction: Beneficiary should contact their bank.

classifications.rootCause: Payment session exceeded configured lifetime
classifications.recommendedAction: Restart payment flow and retry after confirming transaction status.

classifications.rootCause: Transaction matched configured fraud prevention rule
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry automatically. Review risk indicators.
matchHints: Transaction declined by fraud detection rules

classifications.rootCause: Referenced UPI mandate does not exist or is no longer active
classifications.recommendedAction: Verify mandate registration and create a new mandate if required.

classifications.rootCause: Additional authentication validation failed
classifications.recommendedAction: Restart authentication flow and retry only after successful authentication.

classifications.rootCause: Issuer bank debit operation failed
classifications.recommendedAction: Check bank account and transaction state before retry.
matchHints: Bank was unable to debit customer account

classifications.rootCause: Beneficiary bank failed to complete credit operation
classifications.recommendedAction: Verify beneficiary account and bank response. Investigate if failures are repeated.
matchHints: Beneficiary account could not be credited

classifications.rootCause: Configured transaction frequency threshold exceeded
classifications.recommendedAction: Wait before initiating another transaction.

classifications.rootCause: Merchant dynamic QR exceeded its validity period
classifications.recommendedAction: Generate a new merchant QR code.

classifications.rootCause: QR payload failed validation
classifications.recommendedAction: Scan a valid merchant QR code.

classifications.rootCause: Bank API encountered an internal server error
classifications.recommendedAction: Create incident if errors persist and monitor bank API health.
matchHints: Internal server error returned by bank API

classifications.rootCause: API gateway rate limit was exceeded
classifications.recommendedAction: Apply exponential backoff and investigate request volume.

classifications.rootCause: Bank has temporarily disabled UPI services for maintenance
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry during maintenance. Create or update maintenance incident and monitor recovery.
matchHints: Bank UPI services are under scheduled maintenance

classifications.rootCause: Beneficiary account validation returned inconsistent name information
classifications.recommendedAction: Verify beneficiary account details before retrying.
matchHints: Beneficiary validation failed due to account name mismatch

classifications.rootCause: Failed transaction has not yet completed refund processing
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry immediately. Track refund status and reconcile original transaction.
matchHints: Original transaction failed but refund processing is pending

classifications.rootCause: Customer mobile number is not linked to bank account
classifications.recommendedAction: Customer must register mobile number with bank.
matchHints: Mobile number is not registered with bank account

classifications.rootCause: Merchant VPA was not found in UPI directory
classifications.recommendedAction: Verify merchant UPI ID or regenerate merchant QR.
matchHints: Merchant VPA could not be resolved

classifications.rootCause: Bank connector could not establish trusted TLS connection
classifications.recommendedAction: Create technical incident and verify certificate expiry, trust store and certificate chain.
matchHints: TLS certificate validation failed while connecting to bank

classifications.rootCause: Request payload failed API schema validation
classifications.recommendedAction: Inspect request payload and validate against UPI API schema.

classifications.rootCause: Issuer bank reversed transaction after initial debit processing
classifications.recommendedAction: Do not retry until reversal and account balance are reconciled.
matchHints: Transaction reversed by issuer bank after debit attempt

classifications.rootCause: Customer is using unsupported PSP application version
classifications.recommendedAction: Ask customer to update PSP application.
matchHints: PSP application version does not support this transaction

classifications.rootCause: Bank returned response that does not match expected API schema
classifications.recommendedAction: Create technical incident and inspect bank response payload and connector parser.
matchHints: Received invalid response format from issuer bank

classifications.rootCause: Customer account is marked dormant by bank
classifications.recommendedAction: Customer must reactivate account through bank.

classifications.rootCause: Transaction database experienced excessive query latency
classifications.recommendedAction: Create technical incident and investigate database latency, locks and slow queries.
matchHints: Database query timed out while retrieving transaction state

classifications.rootCause: Merchant exceeded configured daily UPI transaction limit
classifications.recommendedAction: Merchant should contact PSP to review or increase transaction limit.

classifications.rootCause: Downstream bank service responded slower than configured timeout
classifications.recommendedAction: Investigate downstream bank latency and use controlled retry with exponential backoff.
matchHints: Transaction processing exceeded configured 30 second timeout

classifications.rootCause: Transaction failed due to an unclassified technical exception
classifications.recommendedAction: Create investigation incident and correlate transaction ID with application, bank and NPCI logs.
matchHints: Unexpected error occurred during UPI transaction processing

fallback.rootCause: No matching classification found in classify.json
